purpose: Fair reporting when unknown targets are masked and unknown input embeddings retain paragraph context
required_training_reports: All original paragraph words and sentence order are retained in encoded context
Known and masked-unknown target counts by split and source kind
Loss denominators count only known supervised targets and are labeled that way
Metrics compare identical fixed encoded windows and masks across checkpoints
Targets after an unknown input remain supervised when their own vocabulary entry is known
No unknown, start, padding or empty token may be produced at runtime
required_evaluation_reports: Unknown input words and positions for every supplied prefix
Do not replace or drop an unknown prefix word silently
Distinguish full-prefix coverage from partial-prefix continuation
Count generated unknown or special tokens as hard failures
Report total and known-target held-out loss separately from human paragraph scores
interpretation: A lower known-target loss with more masking is not automatically a better model. Input-only unknown is a training mechanism, not an on-chain response token.
